edits.target: - Preserve the exact form of asymptotic assertions: note cutoffs, the order of iterated limits, and whether the claim uses a limit or limsup. Do not silently replace a truncated approximation with convergence to a full series.
edits.content: - At an infinite endpoint, distinguish the meanings of limsup and liminf: limsup equal to minus infinity means the quantity is eventually below every finite threshold, while liminf equal to minus infinity may only guarantee arbitrarily late subsequential dips. Do not treat these as equivalent unless existence of the full limit is established.
